what: Many full-panel photos cross-fade with slick fade every 2.5 seconds over .95s, and below center a row of 40px round thumbnails shows only the current one sharp (the rest are at .5 opacity over a translucent panel, .3s). Pressing a thumbnail goes to that slide. No drag, arrows or dots, and it doesn’t pause on hover

options.--fx-bottom: Bottom spacing of the thumbnail row (via style), default 40px
options.[data-fx-part=slides]: Track whose direct children are the image cells (slick is applied)
options.[data-fx-part=thumb]: (If present) thumbnail button — one photo inside, paired with the sections in order

note: slick-carousel@1.8.1 and jquery@2.2.4 are loaded first from _vendor (same build as the original)

from.where: index.html Hero .mk-hero (original .main_img_slider slick fade · speed 950 · autoplaySpeed 2500 + .main_thumb_nav 40px circles margin 0 10px · bottom 40px · img opacity .5 on an rgba panel, .is-active has no panel · opacity 1, transition .3s)
